message:
We’ve all been there—feeling a bit unprepared when it comes to emergencies. But here’s a resource that can help us feel a little more confident: a guide designed just for kids! It’s a great way to involve the whole family in learning about safety and readiness. 

By taking the time to share this knowledge, we can create a sense of calm and assurance for ourselves and our little ones. After all, being the prepared one feels pretty good, doesn’t it? 😊
